requirements.title: Market-data adapters: exchange history fix, CoinMarketCap, FRED/ALFRED

evidence.description: SDK-FINANCE-SOURCES-R001 merged to the default branch in this commit.

requirements.remaining: A central-bank announcement calendar module (agent_connector_sdk.finance.central_bank_calendar) is implemented and unit-tested in this PR's branch, preserving one record per published vintage so a reschedule never overwrites the prior schedule. Remaining: the exchange history retrieval fix and a CoinMarketCap market-data adapter this requirement also names.

requirements.title: FX, commodities, and real-estate adapters with roll and staleness rules

evidence.description: Implementation merged to the default branch; the commit names this requirement.

requirements.remaining: Record contracts for FX rates (base, quote, direction, inversion), commodity prices (spot versus a futures contract with expiry and roll rule) and dated real-estate valuations with staleness are on the default branch with tests (tests/test_finance_records.py). Remaining: the source adapters that produce them, and their offline conformance tests per asset class.

requirements.title: Alpaca account reads and idempotent CSV activity import

evidence.description: SDK-FINANCE-SOURCES-R004 merged to the default branch in this commit.

requirements.remaining: The CSV activity import (column-mapping preview, refusal of ambiguous columns or currencies, idempotent rows keyed by file digest and row identity) and the vendor-neutral account records are on the default branch with tests (tests/test_finance_csv_import.py). Remaining: the brokerage account and position read through a source adapter, and its re-import conformance test.

requirements.title: Macro and liquidity panels: FRED series, ETF flows, sentiment, on-chain

evidence.description: SDK-FINANCE-SOURCES-R005 merged to the default branch in this commit.

requirements.remaining: FRED/ALFRED macro series (vintage-preserved) and an ETF fund-flow panel (net flow and AUM per fund per day) are implemented and tested on the default branch. Remaining: a versioned liquidity composite and heat-strip panel, sentiment data, and on-chain position data.
